heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article54Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
For specific performance of a contract.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date fixed for the performance, or, if no such date is fixed, when the plaintiff has notice that performance is refused.
